comment: Read receipt disclosure policy and per-scope client preference vectors. Spec: discovery/read-receipts.md §2.4-§2.5 and discovery/client-preferences.md §3.6. Disclosure policy is a soft (non-cryptographic) commitment carried by component cells cx.component.space.read_receipt_policy.v1 and cx.component.flow.branch.read_receipt_policy.v1 (cas-register, bottom=reject). User preferences live under the actor-private account-data key cx.read_receipt.preferences. The decision rule is: required > disabled > optional defers to (flow → space → default).

vectors.name: disclosure_required_locks_client_send
vectors.comment: When a Space declares disclosure=required, even a user preference of send=false MUST be overridden — compliant clients send the receipt and lock the UI toggle.

vectors.name: disclosure_disabled_drops_receipt_at_sync_service
vectors.comment: When a Space declares disclosure=disabled, even a user preference of send=true MUST be overridden — compliant clients MUST NOT generate the receipt and Sync Service MUST drop any inbound cx.receipt.read for this scope.

vectors.name: visibility_private_fanout_only_to_sender
vectors.comment: When visibility=private, Sync Service MUST only fanout the receipt to the original sender of the referenced event_id. Other Space/branch members MUST NOT observe it.

vectors.name: branch_overrides_tighten_only
vectors.comment: Flow branch policy MAY tighten the parent Space policy without scope_overrides_allowed=true. Optional → Required at the branch is a tightening (forces send), Members → Private is also a tightening (smaller audience).

vectors.name: branch_overrides_loosen_rejected_when_not_allowed
vectors.comment: When the parent Space declares scope_overrides_allowed=false, a Flow branch MUST NOT loosen the policy (Required→Optional, Private→Public, etc.). Composition keeps the parent value for the loosened field. Reducer SHOULD reject the loosening Move with bottom=reject.

vectors.name: prefs_resolution_flow_overrides_space
vectors.comment: When policy is optional and the user has both space-level and flow-level overrides, the flow override wins (resolution order is flow → space → default).

vectors.name: prefs_resolution_space_overrides_default
vectors.comment: Without a flow-level override, the space-level override wins over the default.
